en: Color postcard view of a snowy Alpine town nestled in a wide valley beneath dramatic jagged mountains. In the foreground people are skiing on a gentle slope overlooking the town. The settlement below has pastel-colored houses with sloped roofs and a prominent church with a tall, narrow bell tower at its center. Terraced fields and scattered chalets climb the opposite hillside, and dark conifer forests and high rocky peaks frame the scene under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
